added_failures_note: the reviewed run declares no baseline_suite/after_suite arms and ran no suite-wide arm, so there is no base arm to subtract: the head-side logs it names (gate_convention.log 4 passed, gate_loader_light.log 1 passed) are green, giving 0 added failures. gate.log in the run directory is an aborted background combined-gate run (rev=520cddc6 while the tree was mid-edit; '.F..' truncated with no EXIT line, the worker having stopped background task bbf2iz1rb) and is not a head arm.

findings.text: follow-on: measure_diiid_convention reads records through loader.load_labels, while plan section 6 names loader.load_shot as the DIII-D loader ("The DIII-D loader is load_shot, which already returns it inside ChallengeShot"). The substitution is justified by the reviewed manifest (load_shot materialises the full ChallengeShot at ~4.2 s/shot, pushing the twenty-shot test past pytest's 300 s default) and both readers assemble the same EfitLabels through _build_labels, so the typed boundary holds; a reader comparing the code to the plan should be told the plan names load_shot.

follow-on: shot=getattr(labels, "shot", f"record-{len(selected)}") is dead -- EfitLabels carries no shot attribute, so the fallback is always taken and the shot labels read record-0, record-1, ... Replace the getattr with the f-string directly.

item_verdicts.diff: read commits a2ac972b..ca5f6d09 against base 520cddc6: 309 insertions and 101 deletions across convention.py (kernel generalisation, corpus constants moved into ConventionEligibility/DIIID_ELIGIBILITY, flux factors rebased on the canonical record), loader.py (EfitLabels lcfs arrays, _build_labels extraction shared by load_shot and load_labels, magnetics resampled onto the EFIT base), test_convention.py (synthetic-EfitLabels kernel tests plus updated twenty-shot assertions) and one evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names measure_convention returning ConventionReceipt, measure_diiid_convention calling it with a DIII-D eligibility holding minimum_plasma_current_ka, standard_field_bcoil_maximum and minimum_audit_shots, all present; EfitLabels gains lcfs_r_m/lcfs_z_m (loader.py:59-60) and validate_loaded_shot guards their shape (loader.py:244-249). The one deviation is the DIII-D record source: the plan and done-when name loader.load_shot, while measure_diiid_convention reads loader.load_labels, a new label-columns-only reader added for the reason recorded in the done-when's own timeout constraint; both build the same EfitLabels through _build_labels (loader.py:98), so the typed boundary is preserved. The kernel and tests are independently reproduced green below.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to generalise the DIII-D convention kernel into measure_convention(records, eligibility, *, shots) over canonical EfitLabels records with DIII-D as its first loader; imas_ambix/challenge/convention.py:283 defines measure_convention with the exact signature, ConventionEligibility at :44 carries the per-corpus thresholds, DIIID_ELIGIBILITY at :68 is the DIII-D declaration, and measure_diiid_convention at :334 delegates to the kernel, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the reviewed manifest at head ca5f6d09; it records status complete, commits a2ac972b and ca5f6d09, the four changed paths, no baseline_suite/after_suite arms, and a negative_control_log whose red run the reviewer re-read.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the two commits change exactly the four declared paths -- imas_ambix/challenge/convention.py, imas_ambix/challenge/loader.py, tests/challenge/test_convention.py, docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-convention-entry.html -- with no figure directory written (the done-when named no figure), so every write is inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: the kernel's flux-sense behaviour is guarded by two in-tree tests -- test_measure_convention_tracks_the_synthetic_flux_sense runs flux_sign=-1 and asserts psi_ip_negative==shots and psi_ip_positive==0, permanently encoding the mutation the negative control applied -- and EfitLabels' new lcfs arrays are shape-guarded in validate_loaded_shot; a later change to the sign or the arrays turns a test red rather than passing silently.
justifications.evidence: independently reproduced in a clean scratch extraction of ca5f6d09 under $TMPDIR -- pytest tests/challenge/test_convention.py gives 4 passed in 43.84 s (EXIT=0) and the label-only loader test passes (12.58 s), matching the reviewed manifest; the twenty-shot test re-pins both ratio medians (1.08030, 0.171935) and per_radian_wins==shots, so the flux-factor rebase to 1.0 and 1/tau is numerically verified; ruff is clean. Deducted because the done-when's literal combined command (pytest test_convention.py test_loader.py) has no completed passing log: the only combined log, gate.log, records an aborted background run (.F.. truncated, no EXIT line is present because the worker stopped background task bbf2iz1rb), and the two 100-shot test_loader.py tests the combined command would collect were deferred as heavy.
justifications.fit: the change follows module idiom -- a frozen ConventionEligibility dataclass beside the existing receipts, __all__ extended, and _build_labels factored so load_shot and load_labels share one EfitLabels assembly; the minor blemish is shot=getattr(labels, "shot", f"record-{len(selected)}") at convention.py:305, where EfitLabels defines no shot attribute so the fallback always fires and the getattr is dead.
justifications.goal_fidelity: measure_convention exists with the exact requested signature and ConventionReceipt return, DIIID_ELIGIBILITY holds the three former constants, and measure_diiid_convention delegates; the only shortfall from the plan is that the DIII-D loader named in the plan (load_shot) is replaced by a new load_labels reader for the timeout reason recorded, a documented substitution rather than an unimplemented goal.
justifications.reuse: the plan's intent to reuse the Grad-Shafranov integral and the sign tests is met -- _integrated_current and _axis_and_boundary are kept and re-pointed at the EfitLabels record, no second scorer or second COCOS transform is written, and load_labels shares _build_labels with load_shot rather than forking the boundary.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches only the four declared paths and writes no figure; the two removed module constants are referenced only by the plan HTML (which documents their move into the eligibility declaration) and by no source or test, so no caller breaks; every commit stays in the assigned worktree and stages explicit paths.
